# ADR-3268: AWS backups: Disabled backup vault lock for vault 4

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Unlocked vaults can be mass-deleted.

## Decision

Compliance vaults MUST NOT keep a disabled backup vault lock for vault 4 (AWS-backups-4) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Vault Lock in compliance mode for regulated data.
